_leagues_help: Leagues are found automatically from your ESPN account. Add one here only if it's missing, or to give it overrides like {"overrides": {"pass_td": 4}}.

league_overrides._help: Leave empty to use exactly what ESPN reports. Add keys here only to test other settings, e.g. {"pass_td": 4, "ppr": 0.5} or {"slots": {"QB":1,"RB":2,"WR":3,"TE":1,"FLEX":1,"D":1,"K":1}}
